summary_md: **Crazy ML ([@crazyMLguy](https://x.com/crazyMLguy/status/2116655451240870361))** summarizes **VibeGame** by Hu et al. ([arXiv 2610.33106](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33106), [tettethu/VibeGame](https://github.com/tettethu/VibeGame), [project](https://vibegame.tettet.org)), an eight-agent team with an AI-native engine that builds, tests and reviews 2D games from prompts and saves reusable templates, scoring 72.99 vs 68.80 for a Codex baseline.
